title: Sunday · a ribbon on a piling
logline: A month after the wedding: the dock, and on one piling, the dog's ribbon, tied there by Maria, going gray in the weather. The strip lets it stay through the summer.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the dock in July light, and on the last piling, a ribbon tied in a bow, already sun-faded, moving in the wind.
